summary: PDD Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing includes earnings highlights such as total revenues of RMB106.2 billion, an 11% increase year-over-year, and operating profit of RMB19.6 billion, up 22%. The press release discusses strategic investments in supply chain and first-party brand business. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer is disclosed. This is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. 8-K earnings release.
